items.html: Also in the tractate Shabbat (page 65b), the amputee goes out with his Kav, according to Rabbi Meir, etc. And the explanation of the matter is that the kings that reigned in the land of Edom and died, which is their breaking and their descent into the world of Beria, and there the phase of the Klipot was revealed, and these kings took hold in the Klipot and became the phase of a soul to them. And it has already been explained above that these kings are the phase of the ZAT of the ten points that came out of the holes of the eyes, as above at length, and these ZAT are the phase of ZA, which includes VAK, and the seventh is the Nukva. And all of them came out separated from one another, not in the manner of lines, as above, and they were not connected to one another, but each one by itself, one below the other, as above; and then it is called the public domain, for there is no "many" but the fathers, as above, which are HGT, as mentioned in the Zohar and in the Tikunim.
